examples.user_query: Retrieve all tenants from the Sisense server.
examples.notes: This call fetches the complete list of tenants defined on the Sisense server. It is useful for multi-tenant deployments to get an overview of all tenants.

examples.user_query: What are all the tenants currently configured on the server?
examples.notes: This retrieves all tenants configured on the Sisense server. It is particularly relevant for administrators managing multi-tenant environments.

examples.user_query: List all tenants available in the system.
examples.notes: Use this call to get a list of all tenants in the system. This is helpful for auditing or administrative purposes in multi-tenant setups.
